apps.name: Beacon Finance
apps.whats_new:
48.21.3  (November 2026)  THE MENU AND EVERY PAGE SCROLL; A CLEAR SEARCH SIGN
  - The left menu scrolls when the window is lower than the menu (on a laptop, or with bigger letters, the pages after
    ADMIN were cut off). The version line stays at the bottom.
  - Every page (Offering Slips to Settings & Audit) scrolls when the window is lower than the page: what was hidden at
    the bottom is reached with the scroll bar or the mouse wheel. A page that fits shows no scroll bar. (The Dashboard
    already scrolled.) A list or a text box under the mouse still scrolls itself.
  - The search box has a drawn magnifying glass (the 🔍 letter was tiny on Windows); clicking it searches too.

apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.45.0 - HELP: UPDATES INSTALL THEMSELVES (setup 1.28.56)
  - A new page, Help (at the bottom of the menu): Check for updates asks the download page for the newest version;
    Update now downloads it, closes the program (with its usual backup and sync to Google Drive), installs it and opens
    it again. Windows asks once for permission: click Yes. The church records are never touched.
  - The program also looks by itself 20 seconds after it opens and asks (Later / Update now); this can be turned off.
    In Usher mode the Help page is hidden.
  - The User Guide (a PDF with pictures of every page) comes with the next update: Help → Open the User Guide.
  - Install this version by hand once (from the download page); after that, updates come through Help.
